answer: Stop sybils at the vertex, not the gate. Every identity is a vertex in an endorsement graph, and its weight is the chance a random wander starting there reaches the honest core: a Sybil cluster's thin cut traps the walk, so clones stay worthless. Each sponsor's k-th vertex costs k squared in bond, so N clones cost about N cubed. A whisper audit then asks random neighbors to vouch in private; one refusal burns the sponsor's whole bond.
